documents.title: Residential Tenancy Agreement (Bengaluru / Mumbai standard with Predatory Terms)
documents.description: Standard-looking Indian 11-month rental agreement packed with high-risk unilateral clauses (excessive deposit, instant eviction, unannounced entry, total deposit forfeiture).
documents.content:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on this 1st day of October 2024 between Mr. R. K. Sharma (hereinafter 'Landlord') and Ananya Verma (hereinafter 'Tenant').

CLAUSE 1: SECURITY DEPOSIT & FORFEITURE
The Tenant shall deposit an interest-free refundable security deposit equal to 10 (ten) months rent, amounting to Rs. 3,50,000/-. In the event the Tenant terminates this agreement before the mandatory 11-month lock-in period, the entire security deposit of Rs. 3,50,000/- shall be forfeited unconditionally by the Landlord as liquidated damages without any accounting of actual loss.

CLAUSE 2: UNANNOUNCED INSPECTION & LANDLORD ACCESS
The Landlord reserves the absolute right to enter and inspect the demised premises at any hour of the day or night with a duplicate master key, without any prior notice to the Tenant, to ensure adherence to house regulations.

CLAUSE 3: RESTRICTION ON GUESTS & MORAL POLICING
The Tenant shall not allow any guests or visitors of the opposite gender, friends, or family to stay overnight under any circumstances. Any breach shall incur an immediate fine of Rs. 10,000 per violation and immediate eviction within 24 hours.

CLAUSE 4: REPAIRS AND STRUCTURAL MAINTENANCE
All repairs, including major structural dampness, roof leakage, plumbing breakdowns, and electrical wiring failures exceeding Rs. 500 shall be borne exclusively by the Tenant regardless of prior wear and tear or pre-existing defects.

CLAUSE 5: RENT ESCALATION
The Landlord reserves the unilateral discretion to increase the monthly rent by up to 20% at any time during the tenancy with 7 days written notice via WhatsApp.

CLAUSE 6: DISPUTE RESOLUTION & JURISDICTION WAIVER
In the event of any dispute, the matter shall be referred to sole arbitration appointed exclusively by the Landlord, and the seat of arbitration shall be in Singapore. The Tenant explicitly waives all rights to file proceedings before the local Rent Controller, District Consumer Forum, or Civil Courts in Karnataka.

documents.title: Digital Lending App Final Warning & Recovery Notice
documents.description: Aggressive illegal recovery notice from an instant loan app threatening criminal arrest, contacting relatives, and visiting workplace violating RBI Fair Practices Code.
documents.content:
FINAL NOTICE BEFORE ARREST & PUBLIC DEFAMATION

LOAN REFERENCE: QK-LOAN-98421
BORROWER NAME: Rajesh Kumar Patel
OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL: Rs. 15,000/- | PENALTY & LATE CHARGES: Rs. 42,500/-

CLAUSE 1: CRIMINAL ARREST THREAT
You have defaulted on your EMI payment for 14 days. Take notice that our legal team has registered a Non-Bailable Arrest Warrant against you under Section 420 of Indian Penal Code at New Delhi Police Headquarters. Police will reach your residential address to arrest you within 24 hours if full payment of Rs. 57,500 is not settled today.

CLAUSE 2: CONTACTING FAMILY AND PHONEBOOK CONTACTS
As per the terms agreed on our Mobile Application, we have extracted your entire phonebook contacts, WhatsApp chats, and gallery. If payment is not received by 4:00 PM today, our automated system will broadcast your photograph marked as 'FRAUDSTER / WANTED DEFAULTER' to all your family members, coworkers, and Facebook friends.

CLAUSE 3: WORKPLACE RECOVERY VISIT
Our field recovery executives are authorized to visit your employer's office and stage a physical recovery camp outside your workplace desk between 9:00 PM and 11:30 PM to recover the outstanding cash amount directly from your management.

CLAUSE 4: ARBITRARY COMPOUNDED PENALTY
A late penalty fee of 5% per day (annualized 1825% APR) shall be compounded daily on the total accumulated balance until full settlement.

documents.title: Police Complaint / Cybercrime Acknowledgement (Hindi + English)
documents.description: Realistic cybercrime complaint acknowledgement report for UPI payment fraud under IT Act Section 66D.
documents.content:
सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी अधिनियम एवं साइबर अपराध शिकायत पावती (CYBER CRIME ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

शिकायत संख्या (Complaint No): CC-DL-2024-88319
दिनांक: 12 सितम्बर 2024
शिकायतकर्ता (Complainant): मदन लाल वर्मा (Madan Lal Verma)

विवरण (CLAUSE 1): ऑनलाइन धोखाधड़ी की घटना
शिकायतकर्ता को बैंक अधिकारी बनकर अज्ञात कॉलर द्वारा कॉल किया गया कि क्रेडिट कार्ड रिवॉर्ड पॉइंट्स एक्सपायर हो रहे हैं। एक लिंक भेजा गया जिस पर क्लिक करने से शिकायतकर्ता के खाते से कुल 85,000 रुपये अनाधिकृत रूप से यूपीआई (UPI) के माध्यम से स्थानांतरित कर लिए गए।

कानूनी प्रावधान (CLAUSE 2): लागू धाराएं
यह मामला सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी अधिनियम 2000 (IT Act, 2000) की धारा 66D (कंप्यूटर संसाधन का उपयोग करके प्रतिरूपण द्वारा धोखाधड़ी) तथा भारतीय न्याय संहिता 2023 की धारा 318(4) (धोखाधड़ी) के अंतर्गत संज्ञेय अपराध के दायरे में आता है।

कार्रवाई निर्देश (CLAUSE 3): बैंक एवं पुलिस निर्देश
शिकायतकर्ता को तुरंत संबंधित बैंक में 'Zero Liability Policy' के तहत लिखित शिकायत दर्ज कराने एवं नेशनल साइबर क्राइम रिपोर्टिंग पोर्टल (हेल्पलाइन 1930) पर शिकायत का टोकन नंबर साझा करने का निर्देश दिया गया है।

REF NO: SC/CBI/NARCO-9921/2024
TO: ALL CITIZENS RECEIVING THIS ELECTRONIC NOTICE

This is to notify you that a consignment containing 5 fake passports, 15 credit cards, and 250 grams of contraband MDMA has been intercepted at Mumbai International Courier Terminal registered in your Aadhaar number. You have been placed under 'Immediate Digital Arrest' effective immediately.

CLAUSE 2: VIDEO CALL SURVEILLANCE REQUIREMENT
You are ordered to lock yourself in a closed room and keep your WhatsApp video call running continuously for 24 hours with CBI Officer R. S. Rathore. Leaving the video camera frame or informing family/lawyer will result in instant commandos raid at your home.

CLAUSE 3: ESCROW VERIFICATION PAYMENT (SCAM RED FLAG)
To clear your name from international terrorist registry, you must immediately transfer a refundable verification bond of Rs. 1,95,000/- to the Reserve Bank of India Temporary Escrow Account via UPI ID: rbi.investigation99@okaxis within 60 minutes. Failure to pay will lead to permanent freezing of all bank accounts.
